card.name: Reviewer credits in A.D.A.M. footers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or the word Review in the credit lines at the end of health-encyclopedia pages. It fires after reviewer names with MD, after Inc, and after Last Editorial.

modes.label: Reviewer name and title
modes.description: The comma or period right after a reviewer's name, degree or company in an A.D.A.M. credit line.
modes.example: David C. Dugdale, III, MD<<,>> Professor of Medicine, Division of General Medicine

modes.label: Copyright and review dates
modes.description: The period after Inc or reserved-rights text, or the word Review in Last Editorial Review.

card.plain: It marks the reviewer and copyright credit lines at the bottom of patient-information web pages.
